description: This file defines authentication-related API endpoints (register, login, logout, get current user) using Express.js. It includes route setup, middleware validation, and Swagger documentation.

methods.name: router.post('/register')
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with email and password, including validation middleware.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate and log in a user with email and password, including validation middleware.

methods.name: router.post('/logout')
methods.description: Endpoint to log out a user, which in JWT stateless auth just signifies termination on client side.

methods.name: router.get('/me')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve current authenticated user info, protected by requireAuth middleware.
